title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.06910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. translated_title: FrontierPhysics：面向端到端物理学研究的智能体评估基准
translated_abstract: AI智能体在物理学研究中正扮演着日益重要的角色。然而，现有的物理学基准仅评估固定问题、孤立的子任务，或在给定解答的情况下复现论文，且很少在检查正确性的同时评估研究质量。我们提出了FrontierPhysics，这是一个端到端基准，包含由42位物理学家基于自身研究设计的56个任务，涵盖理论物理、计算物理和实验物理共九个领域。每个任务要求智能体查阅文献、制定研究计划、开展研究与实验，并产出结构化结果和科学论文手稿。通过将确定性验证器与专家撰写的评分标准相结合，FrontierPhysics能够评估智能体的研究是否正确且具备发表价值。在对22个模型的26种配置的测试中，没有任何配置在其168次试验中通过超过46次。对智能体轨迹的人工审查表明，前沿智能体的主要弱点在于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了FrontierPhysics——一个由42位物理学家基于自身研究设计的包含56个任务、覆盖九个领域的端到端物理研究基准，通过结合确定性验证器与专家评分标准评估AI智能体完成完整物理研究的能力，发现现有模型表现远未达到可发表水平。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark of 56 tasks designed by 42 physicists across nine domains of theoretical, computational, and experimental physics, which evaluates AI agents' ability to conduct complete physics research using deterministic verifiers combined with expert-authored rubrics, and finds that no model configuration passes more than 46 of 168 rollouts.
